hypotheses.Q0_global_selector_is_causal: The unconstrained top-64 intervention moves positively on at least 95% of sites in every layer/pair cell.
hypotheses.Q1_equal_quota_is_efficient: A forced 32+32 selector retains at least 80% of the unconstrained mean finite effect in every cell.
hypotheses.Q2_both_sources_are_causally_needed: The stronger single-position top-64 selector retains less than 90% of the global effect in every position-pair aggregate.
hypotheses.Q3_support_allocation_tracks_causal_stre: The position receiving more global support also has the larger single-position finite effect on at least 80% of sites.
hypotheses.Q4_far_source_survives_balancing: For the 63+119 pair, the far-position-only selector retains at least 20% of the global mean effect at every source layer.
